title: Stateful milestone acceptance map
description: Tracks every stateful environments task (SPEC section 48, plan IDs SE-P0-01 through SE-P6-03) with status, enforcing tests, evidence, and remaining work. Conditional rules that JSON Schema cannot express here (a complete task must name tests and evidence; a pending task must name none) are enforced by tests/stateful-acceptance.test.ts.

id.description: Plan task identifier, for example SE-P1-04.

phase.description: Plan delivery phase of the task.

requirement.description: Authoritative requirement, for example 'SPEC 48.4 · plan P2'.

status.description: Complete only when the task's named checks pass.

tests.description: Existing tests in 'file > title' form. Never a proposed path.

commit.description: Commit that carries the change and its verification.

artifact.description: Repository path of the recorded evidence artifact.

live_provider.description: True only after the required live provider verification passed.

remaining.description: What is left; required on every non-complete task.

requires_live_provider.description: True when a live provider pass is required to complete.

depends_on.description: Task IDs this task depends on.
